description: F0-A's 89 verified gap-cut structures (Pt(111) slabs across the cell boundary, with CO from 1.85 A above the top to the image of the bottom in 15 and 10 A of vacuum, a jittered CONTCAR, two heterostructures, bulk crystals, a molecule in a box, graphene T T F and T T T, equal-gap ties, an info.surface.axis hint, a tilted c), regenerated with the ledger's 1e-5 A tie tolerance and toleranced thresholds (L-F0-16, R5): gapCut of each axis (hint on info.surface.axis), surfaceNormal and findVacuumGap. Positions rounded to 1e-8 A; the cuts agree with the ledger's prototype in every case.

cases.note: O is 3.5 A (block_gap_min) below the image of the bottom layer; stored to 1e-8 A the gap comes out 4.3e-9 A short of 3.5. The block threshold allows position_tolerance, so CO stays a block of its own and the cut stays below the slab, as with the unrounded coordinates
